whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Cake Boss,

I noticed your bakery has phenomenal 4.9★ reviews near Himgiri Chauraha in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for custom cakes and home deliveries.

Maine aapke cake studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, flavour menu, aur delivery inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://thecakeboss-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi The Cake Boss team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cake studio (The Cake Boss) ke Himgiri Chauraha location ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.
